rules.title: Prohibition on the sale or use of coordinated pricing algorithms to set rents or manage occupancy levels
rules.requirement: No one may sell, license, or otherwise provide Berkeley landlords a coordinated pricing algorithm that sets or recommends rents or occupancy levels for residential units in Berkeley. Landlords may not use such an algorithm to set rents or occupancy levels. Each month and each unit counts as a separate violation, with civil penalties of up to $1,000 per violation.

coverage_conditions.notes: Applies to coordinated pricing algorithms that use nonpublic Competitor Data less than 90 days old to recommend rents, fees, occupancy rates, or other lease terms for City of Berkeley landlords.
coverage_conditions.text: Sellers, licensors, or providers of coordinated pricing algorithms to Berkeley landlords, and landlords using these algorithms to set rents or occupancy levels for residential dwelling units in Berkeley. A coordinated pricing algorithm is one that uses nonpublic competitor data less than 90 days old to recommend rents, fees, occupancy rates, or other lease terms.

rules.exemptions: These are excluded from the definition: products that publish aggregated, anonymous rental data without making recommendations; products used to set rent or income limits under government affordable housing guidelines; and products or processes used for market research for project financing, appraisals, or research, testing, or training for software development, as long as competitor data is not an input when a recommendation is calculated.
rules.interaction: The ordinance does not regulate the amount of rent a landlord may charge. Remedies under § 13.63.040: the City Attorney may sue for damages, injunctive relief, restitution, and civil penalties of up to $1,000 per violation. Aggrieved tenants may sue over violations of subsection B, and lease clauses that block a prevailing tenant from recovering attorney's fees are unenforceable for these claims.

rules.requirement: For units fully or partially covered by Berkeley's Rent Ordinance, landlords must pay tenants interest on their security deposit at the end of each year. Under Berkeley's ordinance, fully and partially covered units are subject to the security deposit interest requirement. Exempt units are not.

rules.title: Cartwright Act: prohibition on use or distribution of common pricing algorithms (AB 325)
rules.requirement: It is unlawful to use or distribute a common pricing algorithm as part of a contract, trust combination, or conspiracy to restrain trade. It is also unlawful to use or distribute one while coercing another person to set or adopt a price or commercial term recommended by the algorithm for the same or similar products or services in California.

exemption_conditions.condition: "Person" does not include the end consumer of a product or service.

coverage_conditions.notes: General antitrust rule not limited to rental housing; applies to any products or services. 'Common pricing algorithm' means any methodology, including computer, software, or other technology, used by two or more persons that uses competitor data to recommend, align, stabilize, set, or otherwise influence a price or commercial term (including level of service, availability, output).
coverage_conditions.text: Applies to any person (as defined in B&P Code § 16702) who uses or distributes a common pricing algorithm for products or services in California; not specific to rental housing.

rules.exemptions: The end consumer of a product or service is not a 'person' under the section.
rules.interaction: Part of the Cartwright Act; nothing in the section impairs or limits the applicability of antitrust laws. Companion § 16756.1 relaxes pleading standards for Cartwright Act complaints (plausibility; no need to allege facts excluding independent action).
rules.quoted_span: (a) It shall be unlawful for a person to use or distribute a common pricing algorithm as part of a contract, combination in the form of a trust, or conspiracy to restrain trade or commerce in violation of this chapter.
